svg.title: Pluripotent stem
svg.desc: Round embryonic stem cell with a very large central nucleus and scant teal cytoplasm. Biological basis: Pluripotent stem cells have a high nucleus-to-cytoplasm ratio, prominent nucleoli, and relatively sparse cytoplasmic specialization.
